name: navi-bench-seatgeek
description: A benchmark built around SeatGeek-style queries and data intended to evaluate models on retrieving/event-related question answering and on generating correct API-like responses for ticketing/event information. It measures models' ability to understand event-related user intents and produce accurate, actionable responses or API calls.
reputation: A small, task-focused benchmark with limited adoption, mainly used in niche experiments around event-retrieval and API-generation.
